title: 第2516章 来者不拒第2515章 带你飞
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
黄夜这次并未把机器人送给陈玲儿，两人的两场大战，黄夜也未动用小黄心经。
陈玲儿倒是动用了对双方有利的双修功法，黄夜毫不客气给了差评。
黄夜投之以桃，陈玲儿自然要报之以李。
这妞把随身携带的二十几样宝物统统拿出来交给黄夜，这里面有这妞收购的，也有别人寄卖的。
虽然这二十几样宝物只有六阶品质，整体质量确实不错。
只是黄夜并未照单全收，不过一向对灵宝不感兴趣的黄夜，这次也破天荒的挑了一件灵宝。
主要是这件灵宝的制作材料非常牛逼，部分性能已经达到七阶层次，就是做工差一些，上面绘制的阵法也很垃圾，纯靠材料牛逼才达到六阶极品层次。
黄夜准备回炉改造一下，只是现在还做不到，需要小青进入七阶层次才能分离材料。
最让陈玲儿高兴的是，这家伙真不挑食，跟自己猜测的一样，邪魔鬼怪的东西他全要。
这种类型的宝物即便上拍，也卖不出高价，毕竟参拍的都是正修。
就算有人辅修了邪道功法或者鬼道功法，也不会显露出来。
参拍这种类型宝物的正修，都抱着捡漏的心态，低价拍到这种类型的宝物，回头跟邪修和鬼修交换价值更高的东西。
就像这次的两簇六阶鬼火，拍出去的价格还不到五阶灵火的一半。
所以很多持宝人更愿意通过陈玲儿的渠道，把这种类型的宝物销售出去，只有不了解内幕的持宝人才会送拍。
黄夜又收获了两簇六阶鬼火，品质比姐妹花拍下的更好。
其中一簇已到六阶顶级层次，另一簇也达到上品层次，而姐妹花买那两簇只是中品层次的鬼火。
黄夜还收获一簇六阶上品层次和一簇五阶中品层次的邪火。
陈玲儿也解释了为何宝物中没有低阶层次的邪火和鬼火，原来这妞接触的客户都是六七阶修士，品阶低的火焰很难卖出去。
黄夜指示陈玲儿，将来不论遇到什么层次的火焰，一律照单全收。
对小青来说，哪怕只有一阶的火焰，也比火晶强数倍。

陈玲儿提到还有一枚储物戒，并未带在身上，里面有不少六阶层次的邪魔鬼怪的兵器和典籍，问黄夜收不收。
黄夜自然不客气，表示一个也不放过。
陈玲儿从黄夜挑选宝物的类型也看出点名堂，修士常用的灵宝、丹药、符宝和阵法，这货一律不收，其它的几乎来者不拒。
看到黄夜把需要的宝物收入储物戒，陈玲儿极其认真的掏出算盘，计算每一件宝物的价格，小嘴还不停叭叭。
黄夜大致听明白了，这妞就是个奸商，这钱都是两头挣，利润基本能翻倍，有的甚至翻几倍。
这妞还算有点儿良心，算完账后，这妞提到黄夜这次拿走的所有宝物都不算钱，全当购买解毒丹和那瓶丹药的费用。
黄夜很是无语，直接掏出一张聚宝金卡扔给陈玲儿。
告诉这妞金卡是全新的，随时能提取一百万紫晶，提走的钱下个月能自动补全。
content_en:
Huang Ye did not give the robot to Chen Ling'er this time, and Huang Ye did not use the Xiao Huang Heart Sutra in the two battles between the two.
Chen Ling'er did use dual cultivation techniques that were beneficial to both parties, but Huang Ye unceremoniously gave a negative review.
Huang Ye gave him a peach, and Chen Ling'er naturally wanted to repay him with a plum.
This girl took out all the twenty or so treasures she carried with her and gave them to Huang Ye. Some of them were bought by this girl and some were consigned by others.
Although these twenty-odd treasures are only of sixth-level quality, the overall quality is indeed good.
It's just that Huang Ye didn't take all the orders, but Huang Ye, who had never been interested in spiritual treasures, chose a spiritual treasure for the first time this time.
The main reason is that the materials used to make this spiritual treasure are very good, and some of its properties have reached the seventh level. However, the workmanship is poor, and the formations drawn on it are also rubbish. It only relies on the excellent materials to reach the sixth level.
Huang Ye is going to renovate it, but it's not possible yet. Xiao Qing needs to enter the seventh level to separate the materials.
What pleased Chen Ling'er the most was that this guy was really not picky about food. Just as he had guessed, he wanted all kinds of evil things.
Even if this type of treasure is put up for auction, it will not fetch a high price. After all, the people participating in the auction are all regular cultivators.
Even if someone has minored in evil or ghost methods, it will not be revealed.
The honest cultivators who participated in the bidding of this type of treasures all had the mentality of picking up the missing items, and bought this type of treasures at a low price, and later exchanged them with the evil cultivators and ghost cultivators for something of higher value.
Just like the two clusters of sixth-level will-o'-the-wisps this time, the auction price was less than half of the fifth-level spiritual fire.
Therefore, many treasure holders prefer to sell this type of treasure through Chen Ling'er's channels. Only treasure holders who do not understand the inside story will send it for auction.
Huang Ye harvested two more clusters of sixth-order will-o'-the-wisps, the quality of which was better than the ones taken by the sisters.
One of the clusters has reached the top level of the sixth level, and the other cluster has also reached the high-grade level. The two clusters that the sisters bought are only mid-grade will-o'-the-wisps.
Huang Ye also harvested a cluster of sixth-order high-grade evil fire and a cluster of fifth-order mid-grade evil fire.
Chen Ling'er also explained why there were no low-level evil fires and will-o'-the-wisps in the treasure. It turned out that the customers this girl came into contact with were all sixth- and seventh-level monks, and it was difficult to sell low-level flames.
Huang Ye instructed Chen Ling'er that no matter what level of flames she encounters in the future, she will accept them all.
For Xiao Qing, even a first-level flame is several times stronger than a fire crystal.
Chen Ling'er mentioned that there was another storage ring that she didn't bring with her. It contained many weapons and books about six levels of evil spirits and monsters, and asked Huang Ye if he would keep it.
Huang Ye was naturally rude and said that he would not let anyone go.
Chen Ling'er also saw some clues from the types of treasures Huang Ye chose. They would not accept the spiritual treasures, elixirs, talisman treasures and formations commonly used by monks, and almost everyone else would be accepted.
Seeing Huang Ye put the needed treasures into the storage ring, Chen Ling'er took out her abacus very seriously and calculated the price of each treasure, her little mouth kept babbling.
Huang Ye roughly understood that this girl was a profiteer. She made money from both ends, and her profits could basically be doubled, or even several times.
This girl still had some conscience. After settling the accounts, she mentioned that all the treasures Huang Ye took away this time were not considered money, but were all used to pay for the detoxification pill and the bottle of pill.
Huang Ye was speechless and took out a gold treasure card and threw it to Chen Ling'er.
Tell this girl that the gold card is brand new and you can withdraw one million amethysts at any time. The money you withdraw will be automatically replenished next month.
